fullDescription: A premium dark aurora-glass SaaS marketing site: frosted pill nav, duotone aqua-to-magenta hero, a floating infinite-canvas mockup, a 6-card feature grid, bento showcase, 3-tier pricing with a featured Pro plan, and a glass footer.
prompt:
## Resumo
Build a premium dark glassmorphic SaaS marketing site for 'Prismline' on a near-black page (#0b0f14) lit by soft aqua-to-magenta aurora blobs. A sticky frosted-glass pill nav floats over a centered hero with duotone gradient text, a floating frosted dashboard-canvas mockup, a logo strip, a 6-card feature grid, a bento showcase, a 3-tier pricing block with a featured Pro plan, a big glass CTA, and a 5-column glass footer.

## Estilo Visual
Palette: page base #0b0f14 (also the dark button label color), body text #e7ecf2 with muted whites (white/65, white/55, white/45, white/35). Accent family only: aqua #2dd4bf, aqua-soft #5eead4, cyan #22d3ee, magenta #e879f9. Frosted glass surfaces: .glass = linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.07), rgba(255,255,255,0.02)) with backdrop-filter blur(18px) saturate(140%) and a 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.10) border; .glass-strong = linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.10), rgba(255,255,255,0.03)) with blur(26px) saturate(150%) and a 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.14) border. Duotone gradient text (.duo-text) = linear-gradient(100deg, #2dd4bf 0%, #5eead4 35%, #e879f9 100%) clipped to text. Primary CTA buttons = linear-gradient(135deg, #5eead4, #2dd4bf) with #0b0f14 label text; secondary = glass with white/80 text. Aurora blobs = large blurred (filter blur(90px)) ~0.2-0.55 opacity circles of #2dd4bf, #e879f9 and #22d3ee scattered behind sections. Subtle 56px x 56px grid texture (rgba(255,255,255,0.04) lines) radially masked at section tops, plus a faint fractal-noise overlay at ~0.035 opacity. Gradient ring borders use a 135deg aqua->magenta mask trick. Fonts via Google Fonts: Space Grotesk (display, weights 400-700) for the wordmark, all headings, badges and buttons; Inter (body, weights 400-700) for paragraphs and lists. Tight display tracking, leading ~1.02 on the big hero. Mood: premium, frosted, luminous-on-dark; antialiased.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Global background
Fixed full-viewport -z-10 layer holding 6 large blurred aurora blobs (aqua/magenta/cyan, opacity 0.20-0.42) at varying top offsets, a top vignette gradient (rgba(11,15,20,0.85) -> transparent over h-44) so the nav rests on a calm field, and a faint fractal-noise overlay.

### Sticky nav
A sticky top-0 z-50 header; inside a max-w-6xl container with mt-4, a .glass rounded-2xl pill (h-14, px-4/px-5) flex justify-between: left = gradient sparkle logo tile (w-8 h-8 rounded-lg, linear-gradient(135deg,#2dd4bf,#e879f9), ph:sparkle-fill icon in #0b0f14) plus 'Prismline' wordmark in Space Grotesk 600; center (hidden md:flex) = nav links Features / Showcase / Pricing / Library in white/65 with hover:white; right = a text 'Sign in' link and a gradient 'Start free' pill button.

### Hero
Centered section, pt-28, with a radial grid-fade behind it. A small .glass rounded-full badge ('NEW' gradient chip + '320+ aurora-glass website prompts' + arrow). H1 in Space Grotesk 700, 44/64/76px responsive: 'Ship a SaaS site that' on line one, then a duo-text span 'looks designed, not generated'. A max-w-xl white/60 subhead. Two CTAs: gradient 'Generate my site' and a glass 'See the canvas' with a play icon.

### Floating dashboard mockup
Below the hero, a max-w-5xl .glass-strong gradient-ring rounded-[28px] frame (p-2.5/p-3) with a back glow (radial aqua + magenta). Inside, a dark rounded panel with a mock toolbar (cursor icon + 'prismline / canvas', plus 'Generate' and gradient 'Export' chips) over a min-h ~340px canvas: a 12-col grid of small .glass cards labeled Hero / Pricing ($29 in duo-text) / a +38% metric tile / a Bento grid tile / an avatar+lines tile, over a faint grid texture.

### Logo strip
An eyebrow 'Designed in Prismline, shipped by teams at' (uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], white/35) above a flex-wrap row of 6 wordmark logos (Northwind, Vectary, Cobalt, Lumen, Driftly, Halcyon) in Space Grotesk 600, white/40.

### Feature grid
Section #features: centered glass badge eyebrow + H2 'Packed with the parts of a [great SaaS site]' (duo-text span). A responsive 1/2/3-col grid of 6 .glass rounded-2xl cards; each card has an 11px rounded gradient icon tile (alternating aqua/magenta tints) with a Phosphor icon, a Space Grotesk 600 title, and a white/55 description. Cards: Prompt to layout, Bento composer, Glass tokens, Responsive by default, Clean export, Prompt library.

### Bento showcase
Section #bento: a big .glass rounded-3xl card split lg:grid-cols-2 (left = 'Live canvas' eyebrow, H3 with duo-text 'infinite canvas', copy, and a 3-item check list; right = a nested glass-strong mini canvas mockup with floating tiles), followed by a two-up row of two .glass rounded-3xl cards ('Duotone aurora themes' with a swatch row, 'From idea to deploy' with a main -> deployed pill flow). Each card carries its own corner aurora blob.

### Pricing
Section #pricing: centered magenta glass badge + H2 'Pick a plan, [start shipping]'. A md:grid-cols-3 items-stretch row of 3 plan cards. Starter ($0/mo, .glass) and Team ($89/mo, .glass) are plain; Pro ($29/mo, duo-text price) is the featured center card: .glass-strong + gradient ring + scale-[1.02] + corner auroras + a gradient 'POPULAR' pill. Each card: plan name, one-line descriptor, big Space Grotesk 700 price + /mo, a check list (ph:check in aqua), and a CTA (gradient for Pro, glass-strong for the others).

### CTA band
A .glass-strong gradient-ring rounded-[32px] band (p-10/p-16) centered, with aqua + magenta corner auroras: H2 'Your next site is [one prompt away]' (duo-text span), a max-w-lg white/60 subline, and two buttons (gradient 'Create your account' + glass 'Browse the library').

### Footer
A .glass rounded-3xl footer in a 5-col grid: a 2-col brand block (logo tile + wordmark, one-line description, X/GitHub/YouTube icon links) and three link columns (Product, Library, Company). A top hairline (border-white/[0.07]) above a bottom row: copyright left, Privacy/Terms links + an 'All systems normal' aqua-dot status indicator right; stacks on mobile.

### Responsive reflow
Desktop (1280): full 12-col grids, 3-col features, 3-col pricing, lg:grid-cols-2 bento. Tablet (768): features 2-col, mockup grids tighten, nav center links may hide below md. Mobile (390): single column throughout, CTAs go full-width stacked, nav collapses to logo + 'Start free', hero type scales to 44px, paddings reduce.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
Sticky frosted-glass pill navbar that floats with a top margin over an aurora field (not a flush bar).

### Componente
Duotone gradient text (.duo-text aqua->aqua-soft->magenta) used on hero, section headings and the Pro price.

### Componente
Gradient-ring border trick (135deg aqua->magenta) on the mockup frame, Pro pricing card and CTA band.

### Componente
Floating frosted 'infinite canvas' mockup: glass-strong frame, mock toolbar, and a grid of placeholder glass tiles over a faint 56px grid texture.

### Componente
Layered aurora light field: large blurred (90px) aqua/magenta/cyan blobs behind every major section, with per-section corner blobs.

### Componente
Gradient pill badges ('NEW', 'POPULAR') and gradient CTA buttons with dark (#0b0f14) label text.

### Componente
Status indicator: small aqua dot + 'All systems normal' in the footer.

### Componente
Phosphor (iconify) icons throughout: ph:sparkle-fill, ph:magic-wand-fill, ph:squares-four-fill, ph:check, ph:rocket-launch-fill, etc.

## Notas Especiais
Keep accents strictly in the aqua / aqua-soft / cyan / magenta family on the near-black #0b0f14 base; do not introduce generic indigo or violet AI-slop gradients. Glass panels must stay translucent (backdrop-blur) with 1px hairline borders, never solid fills. All gradient-on-dark text and white/xx body copy must remain WCAG-legible. Load Space Grotesk + Inter from Google Fonts and Phosphor icons via iconify. No em-dashes in any copy. Render the full page faithfully with responsive rules at 1280 / 768 / 390.
